title: Khaliq Apnay Payghambar Da
body:
Mein zimay wari chana haan, oodi lash koon aap sambhalan dey
<<DIVIDER>>
Oodi amad naal jahan’ ootay mendi soorkuru karbobala kar
<<DIVIDER>>
-Rat rovan walay shaam dai wich, menda Aabid putar beemar sahi,
Akbar bas saal athara da, menday wehray dah mehmaan sahi
Ohday karbal day mosam tai-en, Sajaad koo aan bhira kar
<<DIVIDER>>
-Hovay mojza pak shabab honda, qainath wich pak quran wangoo
Oda jigar’ namaz jaya hoya, oda kad hovay azan wangoo
Oda toar day baray ai khaliq, mendi bhain day naal sila kar
